changelog:
⚡ What's New & Fixed in v1.8.2:

• 🔊 Background Wake-Talk-Listen Fix: JARVIS now properly speaks and continues listening after wake word detection in background mode. Eliminated the bug where JARVIS would wake up but immediately go silent or return to standby.

• 🛡️ Wake Session Protection: New isWakeWordActiveSession flag prevents aggressive background auto-standby timers from killing conversations mid-response. The entire wake→speak→listen→respond cycle is now protected.

• ⏱️ Extended Background Window: Background auto-standby increased from 12s to 30s, with smart deferral if JARVIS is speaking, in follow-up, or processing a wake session.

• 🔄 Smart Greeting Retry: Wake greeting now waits up to 5 extra seconds for Gemini reconnection, preventing silent wakes when WebSocket is re-establishing.

• 📱 Graceful Background Transition: Swiping from recents no longer immediately kills the conversation — active sessions are preserved with scheduled standby.
